text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Ines Fujin was riding
her bicycle to a distant running course,
but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, I need to do first aid...!
Do I have anything on me... Um, um—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Right, maybe a bandage...
Wait, there's no way that'll fix it, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, nothing for it.
Guess I'll go get the flat tire fixed...
